title: Custom providers
body: Connect an OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible gateway. Keys and header values are stored locally and never shown again.
loadFailedBody: The custom provider list did not load.

row.plainHttp: Key is sent unencrypted over HTTP

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.body: This removes the provider, its saved key and its header values. Agents and settings that use it must be changed first.
delete.failed: The provider could not be deleted.

dialog.saveFailed: The provider could not be saved.
dialog.name: Name
dialog.slugHint: Used as custom:{slug}. Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 32 characters. It cannot be changed after saving.
dialog.baseUrlHint: API root including the version, e.g. https://gateway.example.com/v1
dialog.apiKeySaved: Key saved — paste a new key to replace it
dialog.apiKeyHint: Optional. Without a key no authentication header is sent.
dialog.keyWillBeRemoved: The saved key is removed when you save.
dialog.headersHint: Up to 5 headers sent with every request. Values are never shown again.
dialog.structuredHelp: How DevDigest asks the gateway for JSON. Strict: the gateway enforces the schema (recommended). JSON object: the gateway returns JSON and the schema is sent in the prompt. Prompt only: for gateways that support neither; the schema is sent in the prompt. Answers are always checked against the schema and re-asked when invalid.
dialog.jsonObjectReset: JSON object is available only for OpenAI-compatible gateways; Structured output was set to Strict.
dialog.slugInvalid: Use 1–32 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens.

models.title: Models
models.hint: Add models the gateway does not list, or prices so the spend cap counts them.
models.label: Model {n} label
models.idDuplicate: This model ID is already listed.
models.priceInvalid: Enter a price from 0 to 10,000 with at most 6 decimals.
